name: jomel-portfolio
description: Jomel — Full-Stack Web & Mobile App Developer portfolio (Vite + React frontend, Express + Supabase backend).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @jomel/shared" "npm run dev -w @jomel/backend" "npm run dev -w @jomel/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @jomel/shared && npm run build -w @jomel/backend && npm run build -w @jomel/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @jomel/shared && npm run typecheck -w @jomel/backend && npm run typecheck -w @jomel/frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
